export const seedFirebaseData=async function(){let options=arguments.length>0&&arguments[0]!==undefined?arguments[0]:{};const{listingCount=100,skipUsers=false,skipListings=false,skipInterests=false}=options;console.log('🌱 Starting data seeding process...');try{let users=[];let listings=[];let interests=[];// Generate sample users

if(!skipListings){console.log('📦 Generating sample listings...');listings=generateSampleListings(listingCount);for(const listing of listings){await DataService.createItem(listing);// Add small delay to avoid rate limiting
